item.description: What Is WICOP Technology? The Evolution of WICOP 1, 2 and 3 by Seoul Semiconductor From Package-Free Opto-Semiconductors to High-Voltage Operation and Rare-Earth-Free White Light WICOP (Wafer Integrated Chip on PCB) is a package-free opto-semiconductor technology developed by Seoul Semiconductor and Seoul Viosys. item.title: A lensless chip films gigapixel video
item.description: By coding light at the sensor and learning the correlations in a moving scene, a single lensless chip records gigapixel video at a throughput of 20.8 billion pixels per second.
